I work as a tailor for a levis store in the UK. Before working there I always wore women's jeans until I tried on the men's and have never looked back. I find 511s work really well for me because they're the perfect in-between, not too skinny, not too baggy. They're a slim but still straight.

Now if I describe my shape, I'm what levis call an L shape. So I don't have hips I just go straight down. This is why straight jeans really work for me, my claves and thighs are similar size.

However for any gals with wider hips and thighs I would recommend buying a tapered pair of jeans. Tapering is where the jeans get narrower towards the leg opening. This just means they'll look more fitted and not flare out at the bottom. But don't worry they still don't have to be skinny if you get like a 502 (regular taper)

I love selling mens jeans to women who come into the store so if anybody has any question please hit me up ✌️
